transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. It's nice to meet you. Could you tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Hi, Dr. Smith. Well, I came in because my eating just went completely off the rails recently. I usually keep on top of things, but I just... stopped caring about my food tracking. I've been skipping real meals for days, basically just living on coffee and protein bars. I didn't even really notice how bad it was until my clothes started hanging loose on me.
Do you find yourself eating large amounts of food in a short period of time and feeling unable to stop, followed by feelings of guilt or a need to get rid of the calories?

No, I don't really do that. It's not like I'm binge eating or anything like that. I'm just... not eating much at all, really. I just don't have the interest or the focus to sit down and eat a full meal right now.
When you look at yourself in the mirror, are you preoccupied with your body weight or shape?

No, not really. I mean, I notice that my clothes don't fit right anymore, but I'm not obsessing over how I look or trying to lose weight on purpose. I just... I have too many other things going on in my head right now to care about my body shape. It's just not something I'm focused on.
Have you ever gone through a period like this before, where you felt this same lack of interest or motivation, or is this the first time you've felt this way?

I don't think it's ever been quite this noticeable before. It's not just the meal logging that I stopped doing, it's... well, it's everything. I just haven't wanted to do much of anything lately. 

I haven't wanted to go for a hike, or edit photos, or... or even touch the woodworking project I have sitting out in my garage. It's really strange for me, because those are the kinds of things that usually keep me grounded. But right now, the motivation to do any of it just isn't there at all. So, maybe I've had off days in the past, but this complete lack of interest feels different.
Looking back over your life, even if it wasn't as severe as this, have you ever experienced a period of at least two weeks where you felt this same loss of interest or lack of motivation?

No, I don't think so. I mean, like I said, maybe a day or two here and there where I just felt lazy or didn't want to do much. But nothing that lasted for two weeks straight. This really feels like the first time it's been this bad for this long.
Aside from the lack of motivation and interest you mentioned, have you been feeling sad, down, or hopeless most of the day, nearly every day?

Yeah, I have. It really hit me recently when... well, a project sponsor at work questioned my judgment on something. After that happened, it was like the bottom just completely dropped out. 

I've just been sitting in my apartment feeling hollow and... ashamed, I guess. I even found myself crying over regular work emails that I normally would have just handled without a second thought. So, yeah, I've definitely been feeling very down and hopeless pretty much all day.
Have you noticed any changes in your sleep patterns or your energy levels since you've been feeling this way?

Yeah, definitely. My sleep has been really off lately. Even when I actually try to go to sleep, I just keep waking up at weird hours. My mind... it just goes right back to the deployment plan for work, like I can't turn it off. 

And because of that, by the time morning comes around, I feel completely wrecked instead of rested. So my energy is pretty much non-existent right now. I'm just exhausted all day.
Have you noticed if you are moving or speaking much more slowly than usual, or conversely, feeling so restless that you cannot sit still?

No, I don't think so. I mean, I'm really tired, so maybe I'm not moving quite as fast as I normally would, but I wouldn't say I'm moving or talking in slow motion. And I'm definitely not restless. I can sit still just fine... I actually spend most of the day just sitting there because I don't have the energy to get up. So, no, nothing like that.
